d:
Designed to help you stay strong, mobile and active as you age, this workout is a great choice for healthy aging, improving functional fitness and supporting your long-term strength, mobility and independence.
You’ll move through a variety of exercises to get your heart rate up, strengthen your major muscle groups, challenge your balance and improve flexibility. There’s also 4 minutes of walking with light weights to add some extra cardio and upper body strength, plus 4 minutes of low impact cardio intervals where you can pick up the pace and challenge yourself.
